description.value: Blue Nile is an Ethiopian and Eritrean restaurant in central Victoria, serving authentic communal-style meals atop injera flatbread with an array of spiced meat stews, lentils, and vegetable dishes. The restaurant also prepares traditional Bunna (Ethiopian coffee) from scratch — roasting green beans and grinding them with cloves and cinnamon served in a traditional pot. A wide range of vegan and gluten-free options makes it a flexible stop for cyclists with varied dietary needs.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the address (1724 Douglas St, Victoria, BC), phone ((250) 475-6453), and email. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('Take out is always available during our work hours from our regular menu'), and vegetarian/vegan/GF options are explicitly described ('Vegetarian and vegan options are plentiful' and 'All dishes are gluten free except injera'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content. OSM hours include a lunch window not reflected on the website, suggesting the OSM hours may be outdated.
concerns: OSM hours list a lunch service window (11:00-14:00) that is not reflected on the website, which shows dinner-only hours. OSM hours may be outdated.
OSM name is 'Blue Nile African Restaurant' but the website body and About Us page consistently use 'Blue Nile East African Restaurant' — minor name discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant in central Victoria with confirmed takeout and broad dietary options — straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: About Us page: 'Vegetarian and vegan options are plentiful and equally delicious.' Menu page: 'All dishes are gluten free except injera. For Gluten Free option substitute rice instead of Injera.'

wow_evidence: authentic communal-style meals atop injera flatbread … vegan and gluten-free options
